title: Grow documentation incrementally without losing trust
statement: As a change author, I can add product context incrementally while existing documentation is protected from decay, so that adoption stays lightweight without losing trust.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Missing optional documentation is reported without blocking the change.
A change flags existing documentation that no longer matches its linked requirements or code.
A change flags previously explained code that becomes unexplained.
Each growth suggestion explains the documentation improvement it offers.
Each actionable growth suggestion provides one command to apply it.
Growth suggestions are listed separately from current-change requirements.
Growth suggestions are ordered by their relevance to the current change.
The author can decline a growth suggestion without creating an error.
